## Type of Change
<!-- Check the boxes that apply -->
- [ ] `feat` — New feature
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — Code refactor (no feature/fix)
- [ ] `chore` — Dependency updates, tooling
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation only
- [ ] `test` — Adding or fixing tests

Closes #<!-- issue number -->

<!-- Brief description of what was changed and why -->

## Testing Done
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`uv run pytest` / `pnpm test`)
- [ ] E2E tests pass (if applicable)
- [ ] Tested manually on local dev environment
- [ ] DB migration tested (upgrade + downgrade)

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows project conventions (PEP 8 / ESLint / Dart style)
- [ ] No secrets or API keys committed
- [ ] `generateMetadata()` added to any new Next.js pages
- [ ] Paise used for all monetary values (not rupees)
- [ ] Booking state transitions validated server-side (not client)
- [ ] Type hints on all new Python functions
- [ ] No `any` types in TypeScript
